name: Tibble v. Edison International
summary: The Supreme Court held that ERISA's duty of prudence includes a continuing obligation to monitor plan investments, not merely to make prudent choices at the time of initial selection.
significance: Affirmed that ERISA fiduciaries have an ongoing duty to monitor plan investments and remove imprudent ones, which underpins petitioners' argument that Intel's continued offering of poor investment options was a sustained breach.
